none: PAS NLM-D67964: Roman Radiate of Aurelian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Aurelian (270-275). Diameter: 18.07mm, Weight: 1.16gms, die axis: 5. Obverse design: Head with radiate crown facing Right. Obverse inscription: Possibly [IMP CL DOM AVRELIANUS AVG] Reverse design:Securitas standing facing, holding short sceptre and resting on column.. Reverse inscription: [SE]CVRI[T AVG]. Cliff Reeves kindly comments on this coin
